amended.statement: A visitor answers hamper-builder questions, jumps to the summary, and sending without a name is blocked with an inline error and focus on the name field.

flow:hamper-wizard-brief.statement: A visitor answers the hamper builder, is stopped with an inline error when sending without contact details, then sends a WhatsApp brief that carries their occasion and recipient.
